options.name: Flat Patch
options.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create ONE polished logo-and-favicon concept presentation for Codematica, a playful technical learning app in which Patch, a small maintenance robot, restores a ruined city through coding challenges.
Input image: identity reference for Patch ONLY; retain the rounded cream robot shell, dark teal face display, two amber eyes, orange side fittings and short off-center antenna. Reinterpret freely in the specified artistic medium. Do not copy the painterly portrait composition.
Canvas: wide landscape 3:2 presentation board, solid warm ivory #F7F2E8 background, generous whitespace, crisp edge quality.
Layout: left 68% is the main logo, with a distinctive large symbol above the exact wordmark "Codematica"; right 25% shows its matching square favicon/icon, prominently at a useful comparison size, followed underneath by a much simpler tiny-size glyph version of that same favicon. Keep all artwork and lettering safely inside canvas edges. The icon must have no lettering. Separate the right study column only through whitespace.
Only text on the entire image: "Codematica". Spell it exactly, C-o-d-e-m-a-t-i-c-a. No headings, no labels, no slogan, no size numbers, no watermark, no extra typography.
Brand palette: deep teal #203F3E, cream #EDDFBE, warm orange #D88C38, amber #E9BD57, optional muted sage #99A772. Prioritize a recognizable silhouette and favicon legibility. Keep the emblem about a friendly learning/repair companion; no zombies, skulls, gore, weapons, generic AI sparkles, stock graduation caps, or copied brand logos.
This is a design direction for review, not a website screenshot or merchandise mockup.
Art direction for this option:
Flat geometric vector-style identity. Bold rounded shapes, absolutely no gradients, shadows or texture. Simplify Patch to a friendly head with two clear amber pill eyes and one orange antenna dot; build side fittings into the silhouette. Strong clean dark teal outline with generous negative space. Use an original rounded humanist sans-serif wordmark with confident weight. Main mark cream/teal/orange, favicon uses the head on a deep teal rounded square, tiny glyph strips down to eyes and silhouette. Modern, approachable, highly scalable.
